sources.title: Pusher - Gymnasium Documentation
sources.snippet: Description ¶ "Pusher" is a multi-jointed robot arm that is very similar to a human arm. The goal is to move a target cylinder (called object) to a goal position using the robot's end effector (called fingertip). The robot consists of shoulder, elbow, forearm and wrist joints.
